action_items: None blocking — Sovereign UX Extensions backend contract is production-ready.

Optional/minor: routes/health.py:208-214 the cached-branch response deliberately omits `birth_year_applied` (only returns extracted_text, cached=true, birth_year_detected=null). This matches iter31 spec but is inconsistent with the fresh-detection path shape. Frontend must therefore treat birth_year_applied as optional/false when cached=true. Consider always returning `birth_year_applied: false` on the cached branch to keep the response shape uniform.

Optional/minor: routes/achievements.py:78 `check_field` looks up user field but reports `created_at` as `unlocked_at`. That means the badge timestamp equals the user creation date — not the moment the flag actually flipped. Fine for MVP, but if the frontend animates 'just unlocked' toasts based on unlocked_at, this will be wrong. Consider timestamping each flag flip (e.g., biometric_enabled_at, onboarding_completed_at) or using updated_at.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/achievements.py:74-92 _count_for correctly handles both check_field and check_collection paths; guardian OR-direction query on line 87 (`user_id` OR `guardian_user_id`) means angel_first_contact unlocks from either side of the relationship, which is intended.
routes/achievements.py:117-124 progress calculation uses `round(len(unlocked)*100/total)` — matches the response the frontend expects (integer 0-100).

routes/family.py:684-738 voice_circle uses ONE round-trip per collection (users_by_id + sigs_by_uid) instead of N per member — good perf. Self is always added on line 699 so caller is guaranteed to be in the list even without any guardian link. Sort order (self → recorded → not-recorded) will render nicely on the mobile grid.

routes/family.py:721 name is derived as `(u.get('name') or u.get('email') or 'Rodina').split(' ')[0]` — first-name-only for the tile label. Consider preserving full name if the frontend needs it (only first name is currently exposed).
routes/achievements.py CATALOG has exactly 8 entries and their keys match the review-request spec verbatim.
server.py imports the `achievements` route module correctly (line 12), and the route is picked up under /api/achievements without a router prefix conflict.
